nodes.description: HS92 six-digit products shipped with BACI.

nodes.name: stg_hs__codes
nodes.description: HS 1992 nomenclature, all levels.
nodes.sql:
-- HS 1992 hierarchy: level 2 = chapter, 4 = heading, 6 = subheading.
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('hs', 'codes') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        code as hs_code,
        level::tinyint as hs_level,
        nullif(parent_code, 'TOTAL') as parent_code,
        description
    from source
)

select * from renamed

nodes.name: stg_imf__trade_monthly
nodes.description: IMF IMTS monthly flows in long form, one row per reporter x flow x counterpart x month.
nodes.sql:
-- One row per reporter x flow x counterpart x month. Counterpart G001 is the world total;
-- other G*/GX*/TX* codes are IMF regional aggregates and are flagged, not dropped.
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('imf', 'imts_monthly') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        reporter as reporter_iso3,
        case indicator
            when 'XG_FOB_USD' then 'export'
            when 'MG_CIF_USD' then 'import'
        end as flow,
        counterpart as counterpart_code,
        strptime(period, '%Y-M%m')::date as month,
        value_usd,
        counterpart = 'G001' as is_world_total,
        regexp_matches(counterpart, '^[A-Z]{3}$') as is_partner_country,
        loaded_at
    from source
)

select * from renamed

nodes.name: int_country_entities
nodes.description: Maps every BACI country code to a stable country entity, with ISO2 for display names, the map feature to colour, and World Bank region and income group. See `seeds/country_overrides.csv` for the exceptions.

columns.name: entity_code
columns.description:
Country entity code: the ISO 3166 alpha-3 code for current countries; for historical joint
reporters a code of their own (BLX Belgium-Luxembourg until 1998, XSD Sudan until 2011, SCG
Serbia and Montenegro until 2005, ANT Netherlands Antilles until 2010, XSA Southern African
Customs Union until 1999, XEF EFTA n.e.s.). Taiwan is TWN (BACI "Other Asia, nes").

nodes.sql:
-- BACI country code -> stable country entity used everywhere downstream.
-- Most entities are their ISO3 code. Overrides handle the exceptions: joint reporters before a
-- split (Belgium-Luxembourg, Sudan before 2011, Serbia and Montenegro), non-ISO codes (Taiwan as
-- "Other Asia, nes"), and pre-1995 states with no flows (dropped: blank entity_code).
with countries as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_baci__countries') }}
),

overrides as (
    select * from {{ ref('country_overrides') }}
),

worldbank as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_worldbank__countries') }}
),

resolved as (
    select
        countries.baci_code,
        case when overrides.baci_code is null then countries.iso3 else overrides.entity_code end
            as entity_code,
        case when overrides.baci_code is null then countries.iso2 else overrides.iso2 end as iso2,
        case when overrides.baci_code is null then countries.iso3 else overrides.map_iso3 end
            as map_iso3,
        coalesce(overrides.name_en, countries.country_name) as name_en,
        overrides.name_ru,
        overrides.baci_code is not null as is_override,
        overrides.note
    from countries
    left join overrides on countries.baci_code = overrides.baci_code
),

final as (
    select
        resolved.baci_code,
        resolved.entity_code,
        resolved.iso2,
        resolved.map_iso3,
        resolved.name_en,
        resolved.name_ru,
        coalesce(overrides.region, worldbank.region) as region,
        coalesce(overrides.income_group, worldbank.income_group) as income_group,
        resolved.is_override,
        resolved.note
    from resolved
    left join overrides on resolved.baci_code = overrides.baci_code
    left join worldbank on resolved.entity_code = worldbank.iso3
    where resolved.entity_code is not null
)

select * from final

nodes.name: int_exports_hs4_yearly
nodes.description: Exports by country x HS4 heading x year, summed over all partners.
nodes.sql:
-- Exports by country x HS4 heading x year (all partners), the base for RCA and product views.
select
    year,
    exporter_code as entity_code,
    left(hs6, 4) as hs4,
    sum(value_usd) as value_usd
from {{ ref('fct_trade_hs6') }}
group by all

nodes.name: int_imf_pair_monthly
nodes.description: IMF monthly flows pivoted to reporter x partner x month (exports and imports side by side), partner codes resolved to country entities; 'WLD' is the total with the world.
nodes.sql:
{{ config(tags=["monthly"]) }}
-- IMF monthly flows pivoted to one row per reporter x partner x month, partner codes resolved
-- to country entities. 'WLD' holds the reporter's total with the world (IMF G001).
with monthly as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_imf__trade_monthly') }}
    where
        month >= '{{ var("imf_first_month") }}'::date
        and (is_world_total or is_partner_country)
),

entities as (
    select distinct entity_code from {{ ref('int_country_entities') }}
),

pivoted as (
    select
        reporter_iso3 as reporter_code,
        case when is_world_total then 'WLD' else counterpart_code end as partner_code,
        month,
        sum(value_usd) filter (where flow = 'export') as exports_usd,
        sum(value_usd) filter (where flow = 'import') as imports_usd
    from monthly
    group by all
)

select pivoted.*
from pivoted
inner join entities as reporter on pivoted.reporter_code = reporter.entity_code
left join entities as partner on pivoted.partner_code = partner.entity_code
where pivoted.partner_code = 'WLD' or partner.entity_code is not null

nodes.name: int_imports_hs4_yearly
nodes.description: Imports by country x HS4 heading x year, summed over all partners.
nodes.sql:
-- Imports by country x HS4 heading x year (all partners).
select

    importer_code as entity_code,
    left(hs6, 4) as hs4,
    sum(value_usd) as value_usd
from {{ ref('fct_trade_hs6') }}
group by all

nodes.name: int_pair_hs2_yearly
nodes.description: Exporter-to-importer trade by HS2 chapter per year.
nodes.sql:
-- Exporter -> importer trade by HS2 chapter per year (for the partner-pair view).
select
    year,
    exporter_code,
    importer_code,
    left(hs6, 2) as hs2,
    sum(value_usd) as value_usd
from {{ ref('fct_trade_hs6') }}
group by all

nodes.name: int_pair_yearly
nodes.description: Total trade from exporter to importer per year.
nodes.sql:
-- Total goods trade from exporter to importer per year.
select
    year,
    exporter_code,
    importer_code,
    sum(value_usd) as value_usd
from {{ ref('fct_trade_hs6') }}
group by all

nodes.name: int_world_hs4_yearly
nodes.description: World exports per HS4 heading and in total per year — RCA denominators.
nodes.sql:
-- World exports per HS4 heading and in total, per year: the denominators for RCA and shares.
with by_product as (
    select
        year,
        hs4,
        sum(value_usd) as world_product_usd,
        count(*) filter (where value_usd > 0) as exporter_count
    from {{ ref('int_exports_hs4_yearly') }}
    group by all
)

select
    year,
    hs4,
    world_product_usd,
    exporter_count,
    sum(world_product_usd) over (partition by year) as world_total_usd
from by_product

nodes.name: dim_country
nodes.description: One row per country entity that appears in BACI. Display names in English and Russian are generated in the browser from `iso2` (Intl.DisplayNames); `name_ru` is filled only for entities without an ISO2 code.

columns.name: entity_code
columns.description:
Country entity code: the ISO 3166 alpha-3 code for current countries; for historical joint
reporters a code of their own (BLX Belgium-Luxembourg until 1998, XSD Sudan until 2011, SCG
Serbia and Montenegro until 2005, ANT Netherlands Antilles until 2010, XSA Southern African
Customs Union until 1999, XEF EFTA n.e.s.). Taiwan is TWN (BACI "Other Asia, nes").

columns.name: baci_code
columns.description: BACI (UN M49-based) country code.

columns.name: iso2
columns.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, used for localized names; null for non-ISO entities.

columns.name: map_iso3
columns.description: Natural Earth feature (ADM0_A3) to colour on the world map; null if none.

columns.name: name_en
columns.description: English name from BACI or the override seed.

columns.name: name_ru
columns.description: Russian name, only for entities without ISO2.

columns.name: region
columns.description: World Bank region; "Other territories" when the World Bank does not list it.

columns.name: income_group
columns.description: World Bank income group (current classification).

columns.name: first_year
columns.description: First year with exports in BACI.

columns.name: last_year
columns.description: Last year with exports in BACI.

columns.name: is_historical
columns.description: True for entities that stopped reporting (e.g. Belgium-Luxembourg).

columns.name: is_override
columns.description: True when the row comes from `seeds/country_overrides.csv`.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Why the override exists.

nodes.sql:
{{ config(contract={'enforced': true}) }}
-- One row per country entity. Names in Russian (and nicer English names) are produced in the
-- browser from iso2 via Intl.DisplayNames; name_ru is set only where no ISO2 code exists.
with entities as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_country_entities') }}
),

flows as (
    select
        exporter_code as entity_code,
        min(year) as first_year,
        max(year) as last_year
    from {{ ref('fct_trade_hs6') }}
    group by 1
),

final as (
    select
        entities.entity_code::varchar as entity_code,
        entities.baci_code::smallint as baci_code,
        entities.iso2::varchar as iso2,
        entities.map_iso3::varchar as map_iso3,
        entities.name_en::varchar as name_en,
        entities.name_ru::varchar as name_ru,
        coalesce(entities.region, 'Other territories')::varchar as region,
        entities.income_group::varchar as income_group,
        flows.first_year::smallint as first_year,
        flows.last_year::smallint as last_year,
        (flows.last_year is not null and flows.last_year < {{ var('last_year', 2024) }})::boolean
            as is_historical,
        entities.is_override::boolean as is_override,
        entities.note::varchar as note
    from entities
    left join flows on entities.entity_code = flows.entity_code
)

select * from final

nodes.name: dim_product
nodes.description: HS 1992 subheadings (HS6) with heading (HS4), chapter (HS2) and section.

columns.name: hs4
columns.description: HS4 heading — the product grain used in the app.

columns.name: hs4_name
columns.description: Official HS4 title (English).

columns.name: hs2_name_en
columns.description: Short chapter name (seed), official title as fallback.

nodes.sql:
{{ config(contract={'enforced': true}) }}
-- HS 1992 subheading (HS6) with its heading (HS4), chapter (HS2) and section.
-- Short chapter/section names (EN/RU) come from seeds; official titles from the HS reference.
with products as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_baci__products') }}
),

hs as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_hs__codes') }}
),

chapters as (
    select * from {{ ref('hs_chapters') }}
),

sections as (
    select * from {{ ref('hs_sections') }}
),

final as (
    select
        products.hs6::varchar as hs6,
        products.description::varchar as hs6_name,
        left(products.hs6, 4)::varchar as hs4,
        coalesce(heading.description, 'Heading ' || left(products.hs6, 4))::varchar as hs4_name,
        left(products.hs6, 2)::varchar as hs2,
        coalesce(chapters.name_en, chapter.description)::varchar as hs2_name_en,
        chapters.name_ru::varchar as hs2_name_ru,
        sections.section_id::tinyint as section_id,
        sections.roman::varchar as section_roman,
        sections.name_en::varchar as section_name_en,
        sections.name_ru::varchar as section_name_ru
    from products
    left join hs as heading on heading.hs_code = left(products.hs6, 4) and heading.hs_level = 4
    left join hs as chapter on chapter.hs_code = left(products.hs6, 2) and chapter.hs_level = 2
    left join chapters on chapters.chapter = left(products.hs6, 2)
    left join sections
        on left(products.hs6, 2) between sections.first_chapter and sections.last_chapter
)

select * from final

nodes.name: fct_trade_hs6
nodes.description:
Full-detail fact: one row per year x exporter x importer x HS6 product (~270M rows), values in US dollars FOB. Incremental by year (delete+insert); see the model header. **Mirror flows.** Every trade flow is reported twice — by the exporter and by the importer —
and the two rarely agree. BACI reconciles them, weighting each reporter by how reliable its
reports have been historically. BACI figures can therefore differ from a country's own
published totals.

columns.name: exporter_code
columns.description: Exporting country entity.

columns.name: importer_code
columns.description: Importing country entity.

columns.name: value_usd
columns.description: US dollars, FOB.

columns.name: quantity_t
columns.description: Metric tons, when reported.

nodes.name: mart_country_chapter_year
nodes.description: One row per country x HS2 chapter x year — exports, imports, world market share. Powers the World page chapter filter.

columns.name: world_market_share
columns.description: The country's share of world exports of the chapter.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per country x HS2 chapter x year: exports, imports and the country's share of world
-- exports of the chapter. Powers the chapter filter on the World page.
with products as (
    select * from {{ ref('mart_country_product_year') }}
),

chapters as (
    select
        year,
        entity_code,
        left(hs4, 2) as hs2,
        sum(exports_usd) as exports_usd,
        sum(imports_usd) as imports_usd
    from products
    group by all
)

select
    year,
    entity_code,
    hs2,
    exports_usd,
    imports_usd,
    {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'sum(exports_usd) over (partition by year, hs2)') }} as world_market_share
from chapters

nodes.name: mart_country_partner_chapter_year
nodes.description: One row per country x partner x HS2 chapter x year from the country's point of view: exports to and imports from the partner by chapter. Powers the Country page cross-filter (click a market to see its chapters, click a chapter to see its markets).

columns.name: chapter_share_of_partner
columns.description: The chapter's share of the country's exports to this partner.

columns.name: partner_share_of_chapter
columns.description: The partner's share of the country's exports in this chapter.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per country x partner x HS2 chapter x year, from the country's point of view: what it
-- exports to and imports from each partner, by chapter. Powers the cross-filter between the
-- partner ranking and the product treemap on the Country page.
with pairs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_pair_hs2_yearly') }}
),

both_directions as (
    select
        year,
        exporter_code as entity_code,
        importer_code as partner_code,
        hs2,
        value_usd as exports_usd,
        0 as imports_usd
    from pairs
    union all
    select
        year,
        importer_code as entity_code,
        exporter_code as partner_code,
        hs2,
        0 as exports_usd,
        value_usd as imports_usd
    from pairs
),

combined as (
    select
        year,
        entity_code,
        partner_code,
        hs2,
        sum(exports_usd) as exports_usd,
        sum(imports_usd) as imports_usd
    from both_directions
    group by all
),

final as (
    select
        year::smallint as year,
        entity_code,
        partner_code,
        hs2,
        exports_usd,
        imports_usd,
        {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'sum(exports_usd) over (partition by year, entity_code, partner_code)') }}
            as chapter_share_of_partner,
        {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'sum(exports_usd) over (partition by year, entity_code, hs2)') }}
            as partner_share_of_chapter
    from combined
)

select * from final

nodes.name: mart_country_partner_year
nodes.description: One row per country x partner x year from the country's point of view.

columns.name: export_share
columns.description: Partner's share of the country's exports.

columns.name: import_share
columns.description: Partner's share of the country's imports.

columns.name: export_rank
columns.description: 1 = largest export destination that year.

columns.name: import_rank
columns.description: 1 = largest source of imports that year.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per country x partner x year, from the country's point of view:
-- exports to the partner, imports from it, and the partner's rank and share.
with pairs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_pair_yearly') }}
),

both_directions as (
    select
        year,
        exporter_code as entity_code,
        importer_code as partner_code,
        value_usd as exports_usd,
        0 as imports_usd
    from pairs
    union all
    select
        year,
        importer_code as entity_code,
        exporter_code as partner_code,
        0 as exports_usd,
        value_usd as imports_usd
    from pairs
),

combined as (
    select
        year,
        entity_code,
        partner_code,
        sum(exports_usd) as exports_usd,
        sum(imports_usd) as imports_usd
    from both_directions
    group by all
),

final as (
    select
        year::smallint as year,
        entity_code,
        partner_code,
        exports_usd,
        imports_usd,
        exports_usd - imports_usd as balance_usd,
        {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'sum(exports_usd) over (partition by year, entity_code)') }}
            as export_share,
        {{ safe_divide('imports_usd', 'sum(imports_usd) over (partition by year, entity_code)') }}
            as import_share,
        rank() over (partition by year, entity_code order by exports_usd desc) as export_rank,
        rank() over (partition by year, entity_code order by imports_usd desc) as import_rank
    from combined
)

select * from final

nodes.name: mart_country_product_year
nodes.description:
One row per country x HS4 heading x year, with world market share and **Revealed comparative advantage (Balassa index).** The share of a product in a country's
exports divided by the share of that product in world exports:

`RCA = (X_cp / X_c) / (X_wp / X_w)`

RCA ≥ 1 means the country exports relatively more of the product than the world as a whole —
a sign of specialisation. Computed at the HS4 heading level from BACI exports.

columns.name: export_share
columns.description: The heading's share of the country's exports.

columns.name: world_market_share
columns.description: The country's share of world exports of the heading.

columns.name: rca
columns.description: Balassa RCA; null when the country exports nothing.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per country x HS4 heading x year: exports, imports, the country's share of world
-- exports of the product, and revealed comparative advantage (Balassa RCA).
with exports as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_exports_hs4_yearly') }}
),

imports as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_imports_hs4_yearly') }}
),

world as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_world_hs4_yearly') }}
),

country_totals as (
    select
        year,
        entity_code,
        sum(value_usd) as exports_total_usd
    from exports
    group by all
),

combined as (
    select
        coalesce(exports.year, imports.year) as year,
        coalesce(exports.entity_code, imports.entity_code) as entity_code,
        coalesce(exports.hs4, imports.hs4) as hs4,
        coalesce(exports.value_usd, 0) as exports_usd,
        coalesce(imports.value_usd, 0) as imports_usd
    from exports
    full outer join imports
        on
            exports.year = imports.year
            and exports.entity_code = imports.entity_code
            and exports.hs4 = imports.hs4
),

final as (
    select
        combined.year::smallint as year,
        combined.entity_code,
        combined.hs4,
        combined.exports_usd,
        combined.imports_usd,
        {{ safe_divide('combined.exports_usd', 'country_totals.exports_total_usd') }}
            as export_share,
        {{ safe_divide('combined.exports_usd', 'world.world_product_usd') }} as world_market_share,
        {{ rca('combined.exports_usd', 'country_totals.exports_total_usd',
               'world.world_product_usd', 'world.world_total_usd') }} as rca
    from combined
    left join country_totals
        on
            combined.year = country_totals.year
            and combined.entity_code = country_totals.entity_code
    left join world on combined.year = world.year and combined.hs4 = world.hs4
)

select * from final

nodes.name: mart_country_year
nodes.description:
One row per country x year: exports, imports, balance, growth, share of world exports, partner and product concentration (**Herfindahl–Hirschman index** of concentration: the sum of squared shares, from 0 (spread
across many partners or products) to 1 (everything in one). Values above ~0.25 are usually
read as highly concentrated. Computed as `Σv² / (Σv)²`.), and diversification (number of HS4 products with **Revealed comparative advantage (Balassa index).** The share of a product in a country's
exports divided by the share of that product in world exports:

`RCA = (X_cp / X_c) / (X_wp / X_w)`

RCA ≥ 1 means the country exports relatively more of the product than the world as a whole —
a sign of specialisation. Computed at the HS4 heading level from BACI exports.).

columns.name: imports_usd
columns.description: Imports valued FOB (see fob_cif).

columns.name: trade_usd
columns.description: Exports + imports.

columns.name: exports_growth
columns.description: Change in exports vs the previous year (0.1 = +10%).

columns.name: world_export_share
columns.description: Country's share of world exports (0..1).

columns.name: export_partner_hhi
columns.description: Concentration of exports across partners (0..1).

columns.name: export_product_count
columns.description: HS4 headings exported.

columns.name: export_product_hhi
columns.description: Concentration of exports across HS4 headings (0..1).

columns.name: rca_product_count
columns.description: HS4 headings with RCA >= 1 — a diversification measure.

nodes.sql:
{{ config(contract={'enforced': true}) }}
-- One row per country x year: totals, growth, concentration and diversification.
with exports as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_exports_hs4_yearly') }}
),

world as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_world_hs4_yearly') }}
),

pairs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_pair_yearly') }}
),

export_totals as (
    select
        year,
        exporter_code as entity_code,
        sum(value_usd) as exports_usd,
        count(*) filter (where value_usd > 0) as export_partner_count,
        {{ hhi('value_usd') }} as export_partner_hhi,
        arg_max(importer_code, value_usd) as top_export_partner
    from pairs
    group by all
),

import_totals as (
    select
        year,
        importer_code as entity_code,
        sum(value_usd) as imports_usd,
        count(*) filter (where value_usd > 0) as import_partner_count,
        arg_max(exporter_code, value_usd) as top_import_partner
    from pairs
    group by all
),

products as (
    select
        exports.year,
        exports.entity_code,
        count(*) filter (where exports.value_usd > 0) as export_product_count,
        {{ hhi('exports.value_usd') }} as export_product_hhi,
        count(*) filter (
            where {{ rca('exports.value_usd', 'country.exports_usd', 'world.world_product_usd', 'world.world_total_usd') }} >= 1
        ) as rca_product_count,
        arg_max(exports.hs4, exports.value_usd) as top_export_hs4
    from exports
    inner join export_totals as country
        on exports.year = country.year and exports.entity_code = country.entity_code
    inner join world on exports.year = world.year and exports.hs4 = world.hs4
    group by all
),

countries as (
    select entity_code from {{ ref('dim_country') }}
),

years as (
    select distinct year from world
),

combined as (
    select
        years.year,
        countries.entity_code,
        coalesce(export_totals.exports_usd, 0) as exports_usd,
        coalesce(import_totals.imports_usd, 0) as imports_usd,
        export_totals.export_partner_count,
        import_totals.import_partner_count,
        export_totals.export_partner_hhi,
        products.export_product_count,
        products.export_product_hhi,
        products.rca_product_count,
        export_totals.top_export_partner,
        import_totals.top_import_partner,
        products.top_export_hs4
    from years
    cross join countries
    left join export_totals
        on years.year = export_totals.year and countries.entity_code = export_totals.entity_code
    left join import_totals
        on years.year = import_totals.year and countries.entity_code = import_totals.entity_code
    left join products
        on years.year = products.year and countries.entity_code = products.entity_code
    where export_totals.exports_usd is not null or import_totals.imports_usd is not null
),

final as (
    select
        year::smallint as year,
        entity_code::varchar as entity_code,
        exports_usd::double as exports_usd,
        imports_usd::double as imports_usd,
        (exports_usd - imports_usd)::double as balance_usd,
        (exports_usd + imports_usd)::double as trade_usd,
        {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'lag(exports_usd) over (partition by entity_code order by year)') }}
        - 1 as exports_growth,
        {{ safe_divide('imports_usd', 'lag(imports_usd) over (partition by entity_code order by year)') }}
        - 1 as imports_growth,
        {{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'sum(exports_usd) over (partition by year)') }}::double
            as world_export_share,
        export_partner_count::integer as export_partner_count,
        import_partner_count::integer as import_partner_count,
        export_partner_hhi::double as export_partner_hhi,
        export_product_count::integer as export_product_count,
        export_product_hhi::double as export_product_hhi,
        rca_product_count::integer as rca_product_count,
        top_export_partner::varchar as top_export_partner,
        top_import_partner::varchar as top_import_partner,
        top_export_hs4::varchar as top_export_hs4
    from combined
)

select * from final

columns.name: exporter_hhi
columns.description:
**Herfindahl–Hirschman index** of concentration: the sum of squared shares, from 0 (spread
across many partners or products) to 1 (everything in one). Values above ~0.25 are usually
read as highly concentrated. Computed as `Σv² / (Σv)²`.

nodes.sql:
{{ config(contract={'enforced': true}) }}
-- One row per HS4 heading x year: world trade in the product, growth, how concentrated its
-- exporters are, and the leading exporter and importer.
with exports as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_exports_hs4_yearly') }}
),

imports as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_imports_hs4_yearly') }}
),

world as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_world_hs4_yearly') }}
),

exporter_stats as (
    select
        year,
        hs4,
        {{ hhi('value_usd') }} as exporter_hhi,
        arg_max(entity_code, value_usd) as top_exporter,
        max(value_usd) as top_exporter_usd
    from exports
    group by all
),

importer_stats as (
    select
        year,
        hs4,
        arg_max(entity_code, value_usd) as top_importer,
        max(value_usd) as top_importer_usd
    from imports
    group by all
),

final as (
    select
        world.year::smallint as year,
        world.hs4::varchar as hs4,
        world.world_product_usd::double as world_usd,
        {{ safe_divide('world.world_product_usd', 'world.world_total_usd') }}::double
            as world_share,
        (
            {{ safe_divide('world.world_product_usd',
            'lag(world.world_product_usd) over (partition by world.hs4 order by world.year)') }}
            - 1
        )::double as growth,
        world.exporter_count::integer as exporter_count,
        exporter_stats.exporter_hhi::double as exporter_hhi,
        exporter_stats.top_exporter::varchar as top_exporter,
        {{ safe_divide('exporter_stats.top_exporter_usd', 'world.world_product_usd') }}::double
            as top_exporter_share,
        importer_stats.top_importer::varchar as top_importer,
        {{ safe_divide('importer_stats.top_importer_usd', 'world.world_product_usd') }}::double
            as top_importer_share
    from world
    left join exporter_stats on world.year = exporter_stats.year and world.hs4 = exporter_stats.hs4
    left join importer_stats on world.year = importer_stats.year and world.hs4 = importer_stats.hs4
)

nodes.name: mart_source_comparison
nodes.description:
BACI vs IMF annual exports per country on the overlap years (complete IMF years only). Differences are expected — **Mirror flows.** Every trade flow is reported twice — by the exporter and by the importer —
and the two rarely agree. BACI reconciles them, weighting each reporter by how reliable its
reports have been historically. BACI figures can therefore differ from a country's own
published totals. Re-export hubs report goods in transit as their own exports; BACI attributes them to the producing country.

columns.name: imf_vs_baci
columns.description: IMF exports relative to BACI (0.6 = IMF is 60% higher).

nodes.sql:
-- BACI vs IMF annual exports on the overlap years, per country. The gap is methodology, not
-- error: re-export hubs (Netherlands, Belgium, Singapore, UAE) report transit goods as their own
-- exports, while BACI attributes them to the producing country and reconciles mirror flows.
with baci as (
    select
        year,
        entity_code,
        exports_usd
    from {{ ref('mart_country_year') }}
    where year between year('{{ var("imf_first_month") }}'::date) and {{ var('last_year', 2024) }}
),

imf as (
    select
        year(month) as year,
        entity_code,
        sum(exports_usd) as exports_usd,
        count(*) as months
    from {{ ref('mart_trade_monthly') }}
    where partner_code = 'WLD'
    group by all
)

select
    baci.year::smallint as year,
    baci.entity_code,
    baci.exports_usd as baci_exports_usd,
    imf.exports_usd as imf_exports_usd,
    {{ safe_divide('imf.exports_usd', 'baci.exports_usd') }} - 1 as imf_vs_baci,
    rank() over (partition by baci.year order by baci.exports_usd desc) as baci_rank
from baci
inner join imf on baci.year = imf.year and baci.entity_code = imf.entity_code
where imf.months = 12

nodes.name: mart_trade_monthly
nodes.description:
IMF monthly goods trade per reporter x partner ('WLD' = world), with rolling 12-month sums and change against the same month a year earlier. Exports FOB, imports CIF (**FOB vs CIF.** Exports are valued *free on board* (goods at the exporter's border); imports
are usually valued *cost, insurance and freight* (including shipping to the importer). BACI
removes the CIF margin and reports every flow FOB, so a country's imports in BACI are lower
than in its own customs statistics. IMF monthly imports are CIF.).

columns.name: entity_code
columns.description: Reporting country entity.

columns.name: partner_code
columns.description: Partner entity, or WLD for the total with the world.

columns.name: exports_12m_usd
columns.description: Exports over the 12 months ending in `month`.

columns.name: exports_yoy
columns.description: Change vs the same month a year earlier (0.1 = +10%).

nodes.sql:
{{ config(contract={'enforced': true}) }}
-- IMF monthly goods trade per reporter x partner ('WLD' = world total), with rolling 12-month
-- sums and the change against the same month a year earlier.
with monthly as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_imf_pair_monthly') }}
),

final as (
    select
        reporter_code::varchar as entity_code,
        partner_code::varchar as partner_code,
        month::date as month,
        exports_usd::double as exports_usd,
        imports_usd::double as imports_usd,
        sum(exports_usd) over rolling_12::double as exports_12m_usd,
        sum(imports_usd) over rolling_12::double as imports_12m_usd,
        ({{ safe_divide('exports_usd', 'max(exports_usd) over year_ago') }} - 1)::double
            as exports_yoy,
        ({{ safe_divide('imports_usd', 'max(imports_usd) over year_ago') }} - 1)::double
            as imports_yoy
    from monthly
    window
        -- Range frames on dates are exact even when a month is missing (lag would shift).
        year_ago as (
            partition by reporter_code, partner_code order by month
            range between interval 12 month preceding and interval 12 month preceding
        ),
        rolling_12 as (
            partition by reporter_code, partner_code order by month
            range between interval 11 month preceding and current row
        )
)

select * from final
